{"tool": "update_record", "args": {"customer_id": "C-4836", "field": "data_region", "value": "sa-central-3RL2"}}

{"tool": "issue_refund", "args": {"customer_id": "C-4836", "amount": 240}}

{"tool": "lookup_record", "args": {"customer_id": "C-4836"}}

The record confirms the region is now `sa-central-3RL2` and the 240 refund is recorded. Both handoff actions are complete. I'll close the ticket.
